name: Twistlock - Overview
description: The Twistlock - Overview dashboard provides a high-level summary of the state of your environment, including the number of hosts, containers, audit events, rules triggered, and defender incidents. The panels also display information on a variety of critical vulnerabilities by type, severity, and the containers affected.
title: Twistlock - Overview
